name: officedex
description: The AI desktop workspace for documents, slides, and spreadsheets. Wails v2 + React 19 client for OfficeCLI.

scripts.prebuild: npm run prefetch:officecli && npm run prefetch:pptxgenjs-runtime
scripts.build: wails build -ldflags "-X main.appVersion=$(node -p 'require(`./package.json`).version')" && npm run bundle:pptxgenjs-runtime:mac && npm run bundle:officecli:mac
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prefetch:officecli && npm run prefetch:pptxgenjs-runtime && wails build -ldflags "-X main.appVersion=$(node -p 'require(`./package.json`).version')" && node scripts/bundle-runtime.mjs && npm run bundle:pptxgenjs-runtime:mac && npm run bundle:officecli:mac && node scripts/notarize.mjs build/bin/OfficeDex.app
scripts.dist:win: npm run prefetch:officecli && npm run prefetch:pptxgenjs-runtime && wails build -platform windows/amd64 -ldflags "-X main.appVersion=$(node -p 'require(`./package.json`).version')" && npm run bundle:pptxgenjs-runtime:win
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/bundle-licenses.test.mjs scripts/bundle-pptxgenjs-runtime.test.mjs scripts/codesign-bundled-officecli.test.mjs scripts/stage-pptxgenjs-runtime.test.mjs scripts/sync-embedded-pptist.test.mjs scripts/verify-font-licenses.test.mjs scripts/verify-officecli-canvas-contract.test.mjs scripts/verify-officecli-canvas-render.test.mjs scripts/verify-pptxgenjs-runtime.test.mjs scripts/verify-release-version.test.mjs
scripts.test:go: env -u GOROOT go test ./... -count=1 && env -u GOROOT go test -tags officedex_demo ./... -count=1
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run test:scripts && npx vitest run && npm run test:go && npm run test:e2e
